style: Premium Japanese Sengoku Oda Nobunaga and Takeda Shingen cascade slot game art

loadingBackground.use: Loading scene background. Keep lower center clear for a Phaser loading bar.

mainMenuBackground.use: Main menu/title scene background. Place title near top center and buttons in lower center.

gameplaySlotScreenConcept.use: Full gameplay visual reference for slot/cascade layout: jackpot header, 6x5 board, side characters, spin controls.

gameplayBattleBackground.use: Alternate Egyptian battle/temple background, useful for bonus or transition scenes.

setBoss.use: Transparent Set boss/guardian character. Good for left or center feature animations.

heroWarrior.use: Transparent Egyptian hero character. Good for intro, bonus, or side panel art.

slotSymbolsSheet.use: 4x4 symbol sheet source. Slice into 16 icon regions for reel symbols.

slicedSymbols.use: Runtime-ready Phaser symbol textures sliced from the source sheet.

slotControlsSheet.use: Spin button, autoplay, turbo, menu/info/sound icons, bet controls, jackpot panels, FREE GAMES plaque.

egyptianUiKitSheet.use: General Egyptian UI frames: buttons, loading bar frame, HUD panels, icon slots, title plaque.

gameplayNotes.referenceLayout: Premium ATG-style slot/cascade board with jackpot header, ticker/header region, side character art, central 6x5 grid, bottom bet/win panels, and large spin button.
gameplayNotes.bonus: Use 4 to 6 scatter symbols to trigger free games, then show the FREE GAMES plaque and feature character animation.

effects: season cycling: spring petals, summer fireflies, autumn maple leaves, winter snow
gold koban coin shower on wins

characters.notes: Oda Nobunaga corrected to no helmet/kabuto; both are transparent overlay characters with idle, spin, and win animations.

characterPoses.animation: Pose switching only: Nobunaga stands/fires teppo; Shingen stands/waves proper Japanese gunbai. No scale-based action animation.
characterPoses.notes: Takeda wave pose regenerated so the gunbai handle is visibly gripped and no longer floating apart from the hand.

splitUi.notes: Split from Sengoku gameplay UI source so Phaser can layer and reuse jackpot frames, board frame, and spin button separately.

properLayers.notes: These are real isolated layers. UI assets are transparent PNGs generated on chroma key and alpha-extracted, not rectangular crops with background pixels.
